$comment: Generated by node scripts/ci/refresh-test-durations.mjs from successful .github/workflows/pr.yml runs of PRs merged into master, each pinned to the PR's final head SHA and each covering at least 90% of the general server lane. Per file: the cost the timing reporter prints in the General tests (server) jobs, which includes tests, hooks, collection, setup and environment preparation under the lane's own file concurrency. Median across runs. Missing files retain their prior weight or the partitioner's median fallback. Timing changes only partition work; they never authorize skipping a test.
